$comment: Per-repository configuration read by the hooks, the skill and the runner. Copy to .claude/adoption.json and edit the commands to the repository's own npm scripts.

scrub.$comment: OFF by default: provenance is the default, an agent's trailer on the commits it made is the audit trail. A repository doing white-label work opts in with enabled: true (the guard then refuses a commit, a tag, a pull request or an issue that names a tool, day and night; the commit-msg hook too), with the reason in its decisions file; allow lists path substrings its own product terms live under.

provenance.$comment: The opposite option: a disclosure trailer every unattended commit carries (the guard refuses a night commit written without it); empty for none.

ratchet.$comment: The ratchet's configuration (abatty ratchet / abatty baseline): the repository's own probes file, metrics to exclude, kind overrides (hard, ratchet), exempt path patterns; the budgets by kind, the caps and the env module take the standard's defaults unless set here.
